title: ParentTask
description: One node in an orchestration's task dependency graph: a group of one or more RequirementSources routed, or awaiting routing, to a single project. A DeliveryLane is created once a ParentTask is routed and its DAG position allows execution to begin - lane/worker execution status is not duplicated here.

project_id.description: Set once routing resolves this task to a project; absent while unrouted.

source_ids.description: RequirementSource ids grouped into this task.

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency counter; incremented on every applied event.
